# Platform-specific Python Runtime Licenses

These license files cover locked runtime packages that are selected only on
some supported operating systems and therefore may not be installed in the
environment that regenerates `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES`.

| Package | Version | Platforms | Declared license | Source |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| brotlicffi | 1.2.0.1 | alternative Brotli implementation in the universal lock graph | MIT | https://github.com/python-hyper/brotlicffi/tree/v1.2.0.1 |
| colorama | 0.4.6 | Windows | BSD-3-Clause | https://github.com/tartley/colorama/tree/0.4.6 |
| pywin32 | 312 | Windows x86/x64/ARM64 where a wheel is available | PSF and bundled component licenses | https://github.com/mhammond/pywin32/tree/b312 |
| win32-setctime | 1.2.0 | Windows | MIT | https://github.com/Delgan/win32-setctime/tree/1.2.0 |

The files are copied verbatim from the indicated upstream tags.
